results.title: Vietnam and Denmark hold sixth intergovernmental committee session
results.snippet:
Denmark was among the first Nordic countries to ratify the EU-Vietnam Investment Protection Agreement in 2021.

results.title: Belgium’s approval of EU-Vietnam Investment Protection Agreement welcomed
results.snippet:
The host leaders described the Belgian House of Representatives' approval of the EU–Vietnam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA) as tangible evidence of the two countries’ determination and potential to expand economic, trade and investment cooperation.
